notes: Fix: Settings → Licensing no longer crashes — the previous release rendered a generic 'Application error' overlay on some Stripe API versions. Subscription period fields now fall back to the item level (Stripe moved them in newer API versions), and each Stripe section is wrapped in an error boundary so a single bad row shows an inline message instead of taking down the whole page
Version timestamps in the Help drawer + update banner now respect the timezone you've selected in the topbar picker (no more '23:57 UTC' confusion when you've picked Local +02:00)
